components.comment: A multisig proposal: /<locale>/wallet#ms=<chainId>.<multisig>.<safeTxHash>. The fragment is matched here because a path alone is every visit to the web wallet.
A proposal or an invite whose '=' a chat app percent-encoded (#ms%3D… / #msa%3D…, r4b-17): the core reads both.
An invite opened on the site's front page (/en#msa=…, r4b-17).
The same for a regional locale (/zh-TW#msa=…).
A proposal on the front page.
A proposal on a regional locale's front page.
A payment link: /pay?to=…&chain=…&token=…&amount=…. The app hands it to the core's payment_request, which validates it before Send opens prefilled.
The same with a trailing slash.
